prompts.title: Brand & Business Website
prompts.summary: A polished, responsive website for an original business, product or organisation, designed to communicate value and convert visitors.
prompts.requirement: Distinct identity; 5+ purposeful sections; responsive layouts; functional enquiry flow; accessible interactions; SEO-ready structure

prompts.title: Interactive Content Website
prompts.summary: A rich content-led website with original editorial structure, visual storytelling and useful interactive experiences.
prompts.requirement: Strong information architecture; substantial original content; meaningful interactive components; clear navigation; responsive and accessible design

prompts.title: Complete Web Application
prompts.summary: A coherent, production-minded browser application with connected workflows, persistent data and a carefully designed interface.
prompts.requirement: 3+ connected workflows; real CRUD; search and filtering; validated state; local persistence; import/export; responsive and accessible UX

prompts.title: Original 2D Game
prompts.summary: A complete original 2D game whose genre, premise and creative direction are independently chosen by the model.
prompts.requirement: Model-chosen genre; playable core loop; coherent content; working game rules; responsive controls; clear feedback and satisfying outcome

prompts.title: Original 3D Game
prompts.summary: A complete original game built around a genuinely three-dimensional playable experience, with the genre and concept chosen by the model.
prompts.requirement: Real 3D environment and interaction; model-chosen genre; purposeful objective; responsive movement/camera; authored content; reliable rendering and controls

prompts.title: End-to-End Game Masterpiece
prompts.summary: An ambitious, complete story-driven game production combining original worldbuilding, characters, narrative, gameplay systems, art, audio and a finished ending.
prompts.requirement: Complete original story; protagonist and supporting cast with character arcs; 3-act narrative; meaningful dialogue and choices; 4+ interconnected gameplay systems; authored quests/chapters; original visual/audio direction; complete ending; save/load

prompts.title: Interactive Machine Explainer
prompts.summary: An interactive visual explainer of a real machine or physical system, accurate enough for an engineer and beautiful enough to watch.
prompts.requirement: Single source of truth for state; timeline scrubbing; part inspection with accurate explanations; 2+ live readouts; what-if simulation

prompts.title: First-Person 3D Game
prompts.summary: A complete first-person 3D game with pointer-lock controls, an authored environment and gameplay that reacts to the player.
prompts.requirement: Pointer-lock movement with real collision; animated view-model; authored environment; reactive opponents or hazards; complete loop; saved progress; stable frame rate

prompts.title: Browser Desktop OS
prompts.summary: A complete desktop operating system in the browser with its own identity, a real window manager and a shared virtual filesystem.
prompts.requirement: Window manager with snap and z-order; persisted shared filesystem; 8+ working apps including terminal and editor; launcher search; settings that persist; safe input handling

prompts.title: Living 3D World
prompts.summary: An explorable 3D world that feels inhabited: procedural terrain that streams, weather and time that matter, creatures with routines.
prompts.requirement: Seamless exploration with collision; seeded procedural streaming world; time of day and weather that change gameplay; believable inhabitants; save/load and map; cinematic rendering

prompts.title: Generative Artwork
prompts.summary: A seeded, reproducible generative artwork that evolves in real time and is worth watching rather than a screensaver.
prompts.requirement: Deterministic seeding from the URL; three or more distinct scenes over time; collaborative interaction; high-resolution PNG export; adaptive resolution; composed visual language

prompts.title: Professional Creative Tool
prompts.summary: A professional-grade creative tool in the browser: layered, non-destructive, fast and dense enough for real work.
prompts.requirement: Real file open and export; layered non-destructive workflow with undo/redo; eight or more tools; autosave; smooth zoom and pan on large canvases

prompts.title: Strategy Game with AI
prompts.summary: An original strategy or tactics game won by thinking, against an AI opponent that is genuinely hard to beat.
prompts.requirement: Clean rules engine; fair consistent rules with clear outcomes; AI with multiple difficulties using real techniques; three or more scenarios; tutorial; save/load

prompts.title: Physics Engine & Playground
prompts.summary: A 2D rigid-body physics engine written from scratch, with a delightful sandbox built on top of it.
prompts.requirement: Circles and convex polygons with SAT or GJK; friction, restitution and joints; stable stacks; fixed timestep; 500+ bodies; debug overlay; scene save/load

prompts.title: Floating Pagoda Island
prompts.summary: An explorable floating island crowned by a multi-tier pagoda: architecture, geology, water, light and sound built entirely in code.
prompts.requirement: Procedural multi-tier pagoda with construction detail; floating island geology; waterfalls and cloud sea; day cycle with lantern light; exploration and interaction; ambient audio; stable frame rate
